"See you around."

"...Fine. This had better be worth it."

"Good question." "I dreamed Claire was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"I save the best bite for last. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."

lines: d31: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Claire Jain is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d31: 🕯️ Claire Jain is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d31: What Claire kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d31: "Claire's gone." Enrique looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Claire." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d31: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Trong blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d31: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d31: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Claire Jain, 31 days. The mantle passes to Trong Lam.
d31: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Trong Lam, 19 — a trail crew lead. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock.
d31: At the grave, Jae, Enrique, Tebogo speak for Trong — "Claire trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d31: The fire knew Trong before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
